documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Thornbury Energy (fictional, authored test material).
Thornbury Energy had cash on balance sheet of NZD 13.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Thornbury Energy, recurring revenue share in FY2024 was 78.2%. Free cash flow at Thornbury Energy stood at $47800k in FY2024 (reported basis). Thornbury Energy had debt service cover ratio of 2.798x in FY2025. The covenant cure mechanism for Thornbury Energy is understood as follows: cure by equity injection counted as EBITDA.

documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Thornbury Energy (fictional, authored test material).
Thornbury Limited had operating expenses of $267.6m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Thornbury Energy, gross debt in FY2025 was approximately $484m (reported basis). Recurring revenue share at Thornbury Energy stood at 78.435% in FY2024. Thornbury Energy had free cash flow of $47.8m in FY2024 (reported basis).

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Thornbury Energy (fictional, authored test material).
Thornbury Energy had cash on balance sheet of NZD 17.2 million in FY2025 (reported basis). For Thornbury Ltd, operating expenses in FY2025 was $339.2m (reported basis). Gross debt at Thornbury Energy stood at $387.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). Thornbury Energy had debt service cover ratio of 2.79x in FY2025. The covenant cure mechanism for Thornbury Energy is understood as follows: cure by equity injection counted only as debt reduction.
